identification: Timber crate of old hand tools: cast iron cabinet scraper plane (two rosewood-type handles, sole cast No 12, Stanley No.12 pattern), duplex rebate/fillister plane with fence, depth stop and spur (Stanley No.78 pattern), nickel block plane with brass adjuster knob (Stanley 110/9-1/2 type), small swivel bench vice (about 65mm), a Bailey-pattern bench plane (about No.5 jack, rosewood-type knob and tote) in the crate, spokeshave, bit/handle with green grip, pliers/clamps. Maker names not legible in photos.
